game_concept: A adventure race set in Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze, a maze of pillars: the tomb cartographer must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Stat Market: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze: a maze of pillars
core_gameplay_loop: In Pillar Maze, repeat each round: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the tomb cartographer ahead. Then check the profit value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the obelisk by solving code steps involving profit that move the tomb cartographer forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the obelisk first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Stat Market
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stat Market' (Week 7 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Pillar Maze'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Pillar Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
